resolution.note: ship.test.ts: proofEnvironment puts worktree bin/ first on PATH; fixture worktree bin/krn marker printed for a krn Proof, PATH krn for a bare dir

title: pre-push Proof commands run the worktree's krn, not the PATH krn
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16, PR for t-mm9xe3z: pre-push refused the push with "Proof command `krn ledger --since 2026-11-09 --limit 700` exited 70" because the bare `krn` on PATH runs the main checkout's code, not the worktree's fix; the same command via the worktree's bin/krn exits 0.
Outcome: the pre-push Proof runner resolves a leading `krn` to the worktree's bin/krn, so a Proof that exercises the change under review passes in its own worktree; a test asserts the resolution.
Proof: a test in test/ runs the Proof runner in a fixture worktree whose bin/krn prints a marker and asserts the marker is printed for a `krn ...` Proof.
Files: scripts/, src/
